spots.name: Westernmost point of the world and North America
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Attu Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 898 m (2,946 ft).

spots.name: Amna Waterfall
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.

spots.name: Nevidiskov Beach
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.
